units.characteristics: earthly mirth stripped; all joy darkened; the levelling of all ranks
units.gist: the earth emptied and defiled ('they have broken the everlasting covenant'); 'the mirth of tambourines is stilled... ALL JOY HAS GROWN DARK, the gladness of the earth is banished'; all ranks levelled alike (priest/people, slave/master); yet a remnant 'sing for joy over the MAJESTY of the LORD' - the vanity of earthly gladness exposed, God's majesty the only durable joy

units.characteristics: the rewarded waiting; death swallowed, tears wiped; God the stronghold of the poor
units.gist: THE GEM - 'O LORD, you are my God; I will exalt you'; 'you have been a STRONGHOLD to the POOR... a shelter from the storm'; the feast on the mountain; 'HE WILL SWALLOW UP DEATH FOREVER, and the LORD God will WIPE AWAY TEARS from all faces'; 'this is our God; WE HAVE WAITED for him, that he might save us... let us be GLAD and REJOICE in his salvation' - waiting rewarded, death undone, grief wiped, joy

units.characteristics: perfect peace of the stayed mind; the soul yearning and waiting in the night; the vanity of self-deliverance
units.gist: THE GEM - 'you keep him in PERFECT PEACE whose MIND IS STAYED on you, because he TRUSTS in you'; 'trust in the LORD forever, for the LORD is an EVERLASTING ROCK'; 'in the path of your judgments we WAIT for you; your name is the DESIRE of our soul; my SOUL YEARNS for you IN THE NIGHT; my spirit earnestly SEEKS you'; 'we were pregnant, we writhed, but we have given birth to WIND' (self-effort delivers nothing); 'your dead shall live... awake and sing'

units.characteristics: the tended vineyard kept without wrath; the invitation to make peace
units.gist: the reversal of ch.5's vineyard: 'a PLEASANT vineyard... I the LORD am ITS KEEPER; EVERY MOMENT I water it; I keep it night and day; I HAVE NO WRATH'; 'let them lay hold of my PROTECTION, let them MAKE PEACE with me, let them make peace with me'; Jacob takes root and fills the world with fruit; guilt atoned - the once-wild vineyard now cherished, the invitation to peace
